title: The first reply to a dictation in under five seconds

chat.text: You waited about thirty seconds for the drawer's first reply. A Sonnet task mastermind stamps every hop headless (mic, Whisper, stream, agent spawn or resume, first bubble), fixes the biggest one (most likely pre-warming the assistant session when the drawer opens instead of at the first sentence), and proves the first reply under five seconds from the first sentence, or says the floor and why.
